comment: Best math teacher I've ever had. he offers lots of extra credit and is accessible out of class. I had an injury, and he was extremely accommodating. He is the best math teacher in the school. If you do well enough in the class, you don't have to take the final. Most of the quizzes are group which usually makes them easier too. highly reccommend him

Volkan is an awesome guy. He has set up the class for our success, and genuinely wants each person to do well. He really enjoys explaining the 'why' behind math. I go to office hours every week because he is very helpful one on one. Exams were not easy for me even though I've already taken Calc 1, but I still ended with a decent grade!

I would definitely recommend him for Calculus. I wish I could take him for every math class. He was by far my favorite math instructor I've had. Extra credit every test, group quizzes weekly, homework was one assignment a week took less than an hour. He's a kind and reasonable guy. Having prior calc experience is definitely helpful though.

Actually the nicest prof ever. I found him to be pretty difficult because I had not taken calc yet but i studied and was able to do well. He offers a lot of extra credit on each exam and gives practice tests that are just like the real ones. He really wants the students to do well and gives a lot of opportunities to do so. 10/10 recommend

This guy is the GOAT. Best math teacher I've had by far. Super understanding guy. Homework is easy and its only 10-15 questions per week. Extra credit is absolutely huge with 10 free points for each exam. Definitely a big plus to come into calc with already having taken it, but either way, this guy is your best bet for calc at Richmond.

If you didn't take calc in high school do NOT take Volkan. He is nice and funny but goes super fast and doesn't explain what he is doing. Group quizzes were clutch, and exams were tough but life goes on.

this was a very clear course and you always knew what to expect 
gives group quizzes and lots of extra credit for tests!!!!

Volkan is a nice guy but his tests can be difficult. His lectures and very boring and long and can be hard to follow if you are not a very mathy person. He wants you to do well but he is not the best option for a calc class.

His lectures can be long and confusing if you're not math-inclined and the homework is difficult. He is not flexible about quizzes, but practice exams are just like the exams and he holds extra office hours before. He also gives lots of partial credit. be ready to pay attention if you want to understand what's going on. fine for getting math credit

Volkan is a really nice professor but extremely inflexible with missing assignments and quizzes. If you actually want to understand calc I don't recommend his class. Memorizing the practice tests is enough to get an okay grade on tests. Quizzes are challenging but he'll sometimes give credit back. Weekly homework that is never mentioned in class.

He's a really nice guy and if you need extra help he will take the time for you. But he grades so harsh in a calc 1 class for absolutely no reason. If you are not math inclined I wouldn't go for him just because he's 10000000% lectures and nothing else.
Great professor for calc 1. He is very good with explanations and very patient if you have any questions. Gives practice exams which are very similar to the real exams.

If you're not math inclined, you should get good with number sense first. Volkan is literally the best math teacher I ever had in my life. He makes everything clear, connects concepts well, and I genuinely understand the material. But, when it comes time to demonstrate your knowledge, tests and quizzes can be very complex (but not impossible).
I took Volkan my 2nd semester Freshman year for Calculus 1. He was amazing. I went to each office hour, which were incredibly helpful. I'll definitely take him again if I have the chance.

Teaches calc in a very efficient and clear way - I understood more than I did in AP calc. Provides practice exams identical to real exams and homework is graded on mastery. Highly recommend because he is an overall fun guy

worst lecturer I have ever come across. He has the ability to explain things in an clear manner but rarely does, often making material way harder than it is. I took AP Calc in high school and I don't think I've ever had a more frustrating and unbearable class than this. He does give practice tests that are similar to real tests and are helpful

Professor Bakirdan is a good guy. For the most part, it is pretty easy to follow along during class. Allows time for questions. Provides practice tests and changes the numbers on the real tests. The final exam was much harder. HW was difficult, but have multiple attempts, so you are able to get a good grade.

Do you know how different you have to be to be able to teach a course that's essentially "math except each unit has barely anything to do with the last" and *still* manage to make things connect in your students' minds?
I'd rate Volkan four invitations to attend office hours out of five; A++‼️

Dr. Bakirdan is a very nice guy; his lectures are very detailed. Be sure to ask questions as the material is very hard, so getting lost can be very confusing. Discrete Math itself is a very hard class but with this professor he makes it easy to understand and to follow along. He allowed us extra credit and the final to be taken online so take him!
